title: Upgrading my player models with the release of Meshy AI's Meshy 7
author: FabulousExample4605
selftext:
Just last week, Meshy 7 was released by Meshy AI. This made my consider redoing my assets, including the Player and Bacteria models. My player model was still based on a Meshy 5 model!

https://preview.redd.it/618kbdxi07lh1.png?width=883&format=png&auto=webp&s=ada2c9fde1a22bd61154236653ac8c66291df834

This image shows the before and after. On the left we have the Meshy 5 hazmat, and on the right, the new and improved Meshy 7 hazmat player, with mesh and texture refinements performed in Blender.

https://preview.redd.it/bonue0tw07lh1.png?width=1540&format=png&auto=webp&s=0567b34c5f166ea8a6f418a0a0f0f42fb6c89aaf

Now this image showcases the difference between Meshy 6 (on left) and Meshy 7 (on right).  
Much scarier in my opinion.

Both of the new model were refined in Blender before being imported into my game.

What do you think? I'd like to hear your feedback in the comments!

Side note, I posted a month ago about a devlog. This is in the works! I didn't want to rush it, so I'll have it released in the following week.

A quick disclaimer, I am in the Meshy Contributor Program, and receive free credits/Pro months for contributing.
